scientific_integrity: Asymptotic results are supported by analytic reasoning; a standard-library numerical checker supplies finite-grid consistency checks rather than proof of limiting statements. Publication novelty is qualified by potential equivalents in the wider stratified-sampling literature.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional standard-normal upper-tail event with a fixed positive threshold, centered Gaussian proposal, independent one-point-per-equal-probability-stratum sampling and a fixed proposal variance. No generality is asserted for multivariate events, optimized proposals, adaptive stratification, variable thresholds or dependent randomized digital nets. A separate historical precedence assessment is warranted.
title: A Gaussian-proposal phase transition for stratified rare-event quadrature
